page.overview:
Who is Cetalia Delarme?

Cetalia Delarme (pronounced: seh-TAHL-ee-ah deh-LAHR-may) was an Aes Sedai of the Blue Ajah; she was also the head of her Ajah's eyes-and-ears network at the time of the Aiel War.

Cetalia is described as a tall, square-faced woman in sky-blue silk with steel-gray hair in a multitude of blue-beaded braids that hung to her waist., Cetalia Delarmes|comp}} Judging by her appearance, she must have been over two hundred years old when she died.

She was very strong in the One Power, by Aes Sedai standards, with a strength of . It was judged that she was stronger than Moiraine Damodred and Siuan Sanche, at least until they both reached their full potential and demanded "more than mere deference" for her superior strength.

Being the head of the eyes-and-ears system of the Blue Ajah, Cetalia tested Siuan just after she gained the shawl; she used many puzzles in an attempt to find out if Siuan would be useful as an apprentice. Siuan passed the tests and spent her first months, and perhaps years, as an Aes Sedai being worked hard under Cetalia.
